attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7), persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance via /etc/sysctl.d/98-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route set to 0 for all/default/eth0/lo), applied live, then completed the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id, issued systemctl reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reset, and reverified all sysctl values and the config file remained correct post-reboot.
